tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. The deepest stratum at night, the paper by day. Body copy sits here.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Sections, chart plot areas, cards. One step up from ground; never more than two steps stacked.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, menus, popovers, table headers. The top stratum.

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: Hover and selected-row wash, code block fill. Never a container on its own.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, gridlines, table rules. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, axis baselines, focusable outlines. Holds 3:1 on ground, surface and raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and data values, on ground, surface, raised and wash.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, axis labels, metadata. On ground, surface, raised and wash.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: mono labels, years, sources, captions. On ground, surface and raised only (below 4.5:1 on wash).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Links, primary buttons, selection, focus. The default interactive hue; destructive controls may use fail. As text, on every surface and action-soft.

tokens.name: action-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind action text: selected nav item, active filter chip, info callout.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an action fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links. Alias of action, underlined with a 1px rule at 30% until hover.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px solid ring with a 2px ground-colored gap. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: The one signal: the key number, the highlighted series, the warning. At most one editorial orange emphasis per page, slide, or app screen. Necessary warning indicators are exempt. As text, on every surface and sun-soft.

tokens.name: sun-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind sun text: the warning callout, a highlighted table row.

tokens.name: on-sun
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a sun fill. Rare: sun fills are for marks and discs, not buttons.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning state. Alias of sun, always with the ▲ glyph and a word.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success state with the ✓ glyph and a word. Teal, off the red-green axis. As text, on every surface and ok-soft.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind ok text.

tokens.name: fail
tokens.usage: Failure and destructive state with the ✕ glyph and a word. As text, on every surface and fail-soft.

tokens.name: fail-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind fail text.

tokens.name: layer-1
tokens.usage: Ridgeline motif, farthest layer. Atmospheric perspective: far is lighter in both themes.

tokens.name: layer-2
tokens.usage: Ridgeline motif, layer 2.

tokens.name: layer-3
tokens.usage: Ridgeline motif, layer 3.

tokens.name: layer-4
tokens.usage: Ridgeline motif, layer 4.

tokens.name: layer-5
tokens.usage: Ridgeline motif, nearest layer. At night it merges into surface so content can sit on it.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Ridgeline motif background behind the layers and the sun disc.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1, canyon blue. Fixed order, never cycled.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2, sun. When a chart has a focus series, the focus takes series-2 and the rest take series-context.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3, teal. Prefer at most three color-coded scatter or bubble series; use labels and redundant encodings.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4, heather. Lines, bars and stacks only.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5, sand by night and umber on paper. Separated from series-2 by lightness so the pair survives deuteranomaly.

tokens.name: series-6
tokens.usage: Chart series 6, rose. Beyond six categories, filter or split. Aggregate only when analytically valid.

tokens.name: series-context
tokens.usage: Context series in focus mode: every series that is not the story. Recedes on purpose; identity comes from labels.

tokens.name: div-mid
tokens.usage: Diverging midpoint, the neutral zero between ridge (below) and sun (above).

tokens.name: ridge-50
tokens.usage: Ridge ramp step 50. Sequential encoding (light = low on paper, dark = low at night) and the ridgeline motif. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ridge-100
tokens.usage: Ridge ramp step 100. Sequential encoding (light = low on paper, dark = low at night) and the ridgeline motif. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ridge-200
tokens.usage: Ridge ramp step 200. Sequential encoding (light = low on paper, dark = low at night) and the ridgeline motif. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ridge-300
tokens.usage: Ridge ramp step 300. Sequential encoding (light = low on paper, dark = low at night) and the ridgeline motif. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ridge-400
tokens.usage: Ridge ramp step 400. Sequential encoding (light = low on paper, dark = low at night) and the ridgeline motif. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ridge-500
tokens.usage: Ridge ramp step 500. Sequential encoding (light = low on paper, dark = low at night) and the ridgeline motif. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ridge-600
tokens.usage: Ridge ramp step 600. Sequential encoding (light = low on paper, dark = low at night) and the ridgeline motif. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ridge-700
tokens.usage: Ridge ramp step 700. Sequential encoding (light = low on paper, dark = low at night) and the ridgeline motif. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ridge-800
tokens.usage: Ridge ramp step 800. Sequential encoding (light = low on paper, dark = low at night) and the ridgeline motif. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ridge-900
tokens.usage: Ridge ramp step 900. Sequential encoding (light = low on paper, dark = low at night) and the ridgeline motif. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: sun-100
tokens.usage: Sun ramp step 100. Diverging warm arm and illustration (sun-400 is the sun disc). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: sun-200
tokens.usage: Sun ramp step 200. Diverging warm arm and illustration (sun-400 is the sun disc). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: sun-300
tokens.usage: Sun ramp step 300. Diverging warm arm and illustration (sun-400 is the sun disc). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: sun-400
tokens.usage: Sun ramp step 400. Diverging warm arm and illustration (sun-400 is the sun disc). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: sun-500
tokens.usage: Sun ramp step 500. Diverging warm arm and illustration (sun-400 is the sun disc). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: sun-600
tokens.usage: Sun ramp step 600. Diverging warm arm and illustration (sun-400 is the sun disc). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: sun-700
tokens.usage: Sun ramp step 700. Diverging warm arm and illustration (sun-400 is the sun disc). Same in both themes.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page heroes and infographic titles. One per page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Note titles, slide titles, figure headlines.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Sub-sections, card titles, note list titles.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: A lede sets up the page in one or two plain sentences.
styles.usage: The opening paragraph of a page or figure.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Plain words, one idea per sentence, short paragraphs.
styles.usage: Prose. Measure 38em. 17px matches the site and the renderer.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: A short description under a title.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Hero numbers and stat values. Proportional figures.

styles.name: intro
styles.sample: These are notes from the workbench.
styles.usage: The quiet mono voice: site intro, CLI banners, epigraphs.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Axis ticks, chart sources, footnotes, timestamps.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section kickers and field labels. Always uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, control inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding (vertical), list item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding (horizontal), card padding on small screens.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Kicker to content, figure margins.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between major page zones.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero and footer breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default for charts, tables, page sections. Strata are flat.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs, buttons, code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, callouts, menus, terminal windows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Figures and infographic panels that float on ground.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: App and mark tiles only (the rounded square of the mark).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Discs: the sun, dots, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs only. Everything else separates by stratum, not shadow.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Prose column width.

tokens.name: measure-wide
tokens.usage: Figures and tables beside prose.

tokens.name: sidenote
tokens.usage: Sidenote column width, with a 48px gap.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page side padding.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines, gridlines, control borders.

tokens.name: stroke-mark
tokens.usage: Chart lines, focus ring, sparklines.

tokens.name: stroke-ridge
tokens.usage: Ridgeline contours when drawn as lines (the site horizon).

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: Hover color, border.

tokens.name: duration-calm
tokens.usage: Opacity, slide on hover (translateX 4px).

tokens.name: duration-arrive
tokens.usage: fadeUp on first paint: 12px rise, ease, staggered 600ms.

tokens.name: ease-strata
tokens.usage: The one easing curve.
